terminal.alternative: refresh duplicated terminal byte views after every compaction rejected because aliases remain separately maintained
terminal.preserved: canonical checkpoints, terminal observations, cleanup values/reasons, transaction rollback and output commit fence

retentionWitness.input: three bytes arguments: 1MiB repeated 0x39, small, small; return second argument
retentionWitness.failed: Argument ownership alone retained the full imported backing after terminal completion. Repeated terminal observations do not trigger periodic collection.
retentionWitness.repair: A Store-owned terminal exit replaces borrowed terminal fields; terminal collection retains only that root. Compaction prepares current copies under the journal, preserving entry backing until commit; post-commit release allocates nothing.
retentionWitness.validation: Caller overwrite/free, checkpoint/restore, duplicate argument interning, all Session/store allocation failures, journal collection/ID reuse and resident terminal commit/rollback tests pass.
